title: Pipe drainage
intro: L [cm]: Distance between pipes; rad [cm]: Inner radius of drain pipes. Each is varied from half to double the value the farm uses; none of them moved yield, water or nitrogen in the test, so the effect shows in the process itself.

marks.d: Adds a further factor, grouped by Irrigation, Nitrogen and tillage, Weather and climate, Soil and crop, and Chemicals.
